# Priscilla Grant

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v3 c4 P8](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0008), [v3 c4 P11](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** College student and former teacher  <sub>[v2 c1 P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v3 c9 P11](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0011), [v3 c37 P29](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0029)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Pris  <sub>[v3 c4 P15](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0015), [v3 c9 P19](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0019)</sub>

## Appearance

Priscilla is a tall, pale, and spiritual-looking girl with a good two inches more height than her companions, which once made her feel awkwardly large. She has a fair, golden beauty.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P6](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0006), [v3 c4 P10](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0010), [v3 c34 P5](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0005), [v3 c35 P4](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0004)_

## Personality

Priscilla is thoughtful, imaginative, and ambitious, possessing a strong sense of humor and fun. She has a deep love for nature, art, and literature, and is a loyal, unselfish friend. Though sometimes given to wry pessimism, she is deeply appreciative of the beauty and joy in life.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P4](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0004), [v3 c9 P27](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0027), [v3 c13 P75](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0075), [v3 c35 P4](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0004)_

- Thoughtful and imaginative  <sub>[v3 c35 P4](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0004)</sub>

## Goals

- To achieve a college degree at Redmond and pursue her ambitions  <sub>[v3 c1 P21](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0021), [v3 c9 P11](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0011), [v3 c34 P25](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0025)</sub>
- To live independently with her friends at Patty's Place  <sub>[v3 c9 P12](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0012), [v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013)</sub>

## History

Priscilla Grant previously attended Queen's Academy with Anne Shirley and later taught at the Carmody school for a time before accepting a position at her own home school. After two years of teaching, she entered Redmond College as a Sophomore, boarding initially in Kingsport. While in college, she and Anne met Philippa Gordon in Old St. John's Cemetery, becoming close friends with her. Tired of boarding, Priscilla joined Anne, Stella Maynard, and Philippa in renting Patty's Place on Spofford Avenue for their remaining college years, with her Aunt Jamesina acting as housekeeper. During her summer vacation, Priscilla brought her aunt, the noted author Charlotte E. Morgan, to visit Anne at Green Gables. At Redmond, Priscilla devoted herself to classics, graduating with Honors in her Senior year. Following graduation, she went to Japan to work in the mission field.

_Sources: [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v2 c1 P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v2 c6 P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), [v2 c16 P8](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0008), [v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060), [v2 c20 P11](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0011), [v3 c1 P21](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0021), [v3 c3 P10](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0010), [v3 c4 P18](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0018), [v3 c9 P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007), [v3 c9 P11](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0011), [v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 c10 P48](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0048), [v3 c35 P5](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0005), [v3 c37 P29](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0029), [v4 c3 P16](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0016)_
